Your Privacy Choices

As described in our Privacy Policy, we process personal information to inform which ads you see on our services and disclose certain personal information in connection with advertising our services to you on third-party sites and for other ad-related purposes. 

These activities may be considered “sales” or “sharing” of your personal information for “cross-context behavioral advertising,” or “processing” of your personal information for “targeted advertising.” Depending on how you interact with us, the information we process for these activities may be associated with your device or browser, or with your email address (if you have provided it to us). Instructions on how to opt-out from both email and device-based activities are below:

Email Address
To exercise your opt-out rights (as described above) in connection with the email address you provided to us (such as through account registration, newsletters or marketing subscriptions) please submit your request here.

Device Information
To opt out of our use of personal information associated with a device that may be considered “sales,” “sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising” or “targeted advertising” move the toggle to the left and go to the bottom of this pop-up and click “Save Settings.” If you close this pop-up without clicking “Save Settings,” any opt-out settings you have chosen will not be saved. Your choices will apply to all devices accessed with your account if you have an account and are logged in, or to this device only if you are not a logged-in user. You will need to renew this choice in each Paramount Service you visit, if you clear your browser cookies, or if you return to this Paramount Service using a different browser or device and are logged-out user.

Essential

These cookies are essential for the proper functioning of our Services. Essential cookies cannot be switched off in our systems. You can set your device to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the Service will not work.

Allow Sale, Sharing for Cross-Context Behavioral Advertising, or Targeted Advertising

Please make sure you click on the Save Settings button at the bottom or otherwise confirm your opt-out choice.

If you have enabled the Global Privacy Control signal, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of "sales," "sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising" and "targeted advertising" for personal information associated with your device. For more information about how to use the Global Privacy Control signal, please see here.

For instructions on how to stop receiving marketing emails from us, please see here.
